post_title: Tax filing F1 to H1B transition in 2025
concerns_or_questions_summary: Recently transitioned from F-1 to H-1B in October 2025 and is unsure how to file taxes for the year. Considering filing as a non-resident under the Substantial Presence Test exemption and is exploring eligibility for the US-India tax treaty article 21(2). Looking for confirmation from others in a similar situation.
